title: evolution-whatsapp: a modern Python client for the Evolution API v2 (WhatsApp)
description: evolution-whatsapp is a modern Python client for the Evolution API v2 (WhatsApp automation). It is the Python twin of the R package evolution: it mirrors the same function names, parameters and behaviour (a preconfigured client, snake_case send_* helpers, jid()), and adds a modern stack — httpx sync and async clients, pydantic v2 webhook models with parse_webhook(), structlog structured logging, local-file to base64 auto-encoding, automatic retries and typed errors, plus optional FastAPI webhook routing and pandas support for data pipelines.
